summary: A collection README should have quick-start install and usage guidance, like community.general's, and module and plugin docs should be comprehensive.
questions: What should go in my collection's README?
Is there a good example collection README?

answer_card.title: Write collection documentation
answer_card.answer_md: Include quick-start installation and usage in `README.md` (community.general's README is a good model). Make module and plugin docs comprehensive, following the module format guide and the Ansible style guide.
